主要内容: CVS Health, a major player in the U.S. healthcare sector, has announced that its sales are expected to accelerate in the coming year due to its expansion into health-care services. The company, which operates drugstores and provides insurance through Aetna, is reimagining its business model by integrating its pharmacy benefit manager, Caremark, and insurance services. CEO Karen Lynch emphasized that the company is uniquely positioned to address the flaws in the current healthcare system, which is costly and often delivers poor outcomes. During its first investor day since the pandemic began, CVS outlined plans to enhance its offerings, including new health products, subscription models, and home health care options. The company also highlighted its role in the pandemic, having administered over 50 million vaccines and 29 million tests. With about 85% of Americans living within 10 miles of a CVS store, the company is focusing on transforming its locations into healthcare destinations. It plans to close approximately 900 stores over the next three years, streamlining its footprint and emphasizing health-care services in its remaining locations. CVS Health is expanding its healthcare services to boost sales, emphasizing primary care and mental health support. The company aims to make doctor appointments as convenient as restaurant reservations, with extended clinic hours and streamlined processes. CEO Karen Lynch highlighted the need for partnerships or acquisitions to scale primary care. Pandemic-related services, such as Covid tests and vaccines, are expected to generate over $3 billion in revenue this year, though CFO Shawn Guertin noted uncertainty about future demand due to the emergence of the omicron variant. CVS also raised its earnings forecast for fiscal 2022, projecting adjusted earnings per share between $8.10 and $8.30 on revenue of $304 billion to $309 billion. The company plans to resume share buybacks and increase its dividend by 10%, marking its first such move since 2017. Shares have risen 43% this year, with a market value of $128.41 billion.
